title: Replace legacy DSA signatures with an explicit ECDSA contract
goal: Migrate new signatures from unsupported macOS DSA to an agreed ECDSA key and encoding while identifying legacy signed data without reinterpreting it.

selectionNotes: Migrate new signatures from unsupported macOS DSA to an agreed ECDSA key and encoding while identifying legacy signed data without reinterpreting it.
macOS route source-reviewed; macOS10 DSA and macOS11 removal/ECDSA operations not-tested under PIN-699. Windows x64 compilation/execution is measured separately.
Preserve existing key/peer format boundaries; actual-GA and comprehensive gates remain open.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: Current net11 consumer; actual RC2 is measured separately from final GA.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build current .NET11 references; exact RC2 is the reproduction baseline.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Canonical sample mode; selected APIs require no experimental syntax.

providers: macOS ECDSA provider and accessible P-256 certificate/key; Windows CNG used for local proof
platforms: macOS route source-reviewed; macOS10 DSA and macOS11 removal/ECDSA operations not-tested under PIN-699. Windows x64 compilation/execution is measured separately.
prerequisites: Workload-free net11.0 console project, C#15 sample mode, Nullable and ImplicitUsings enabled; canonical helpers in separate files.
Independent P-256 signing certificate/private key and an already trusted peer certificate/key-ID mapping; peers agree SHA256/DER and exact payload bytes.
Legacy comparison fixture: public-only imported DSA1024/SHA1/SPKI/P1363 generated on supporting Windows; no macOS DSA key generation.
constraints: No DSA-to-ECDSA key/signature conversion. UnsupportedLegacy never means authenticated; no fallback or relabelling of archived data.
Certificate trust/revocation/provisioning and production keys are outside this contract. DSA certificate failures on macOS are source-reviewed, not executed.

Framework APIs only; no NuGet packages, workloads, rendering mode or experimental opt-ins. Previous SDK10.0.402/runtime10.0.13 and current SDK11RC2/runtime11RC2 are verification pins, not supported consumer minimums.
stabilityLimitations: Stable APIs; actual .NET11 GA reconciliation remains open. RC2 evidence is not final-GA proof.

sources.title: macOS DSA removal and supported historical limits

evidence.scope: Windows paired compile/run: imported DSA fixture and real ECDSA P256/SHA256/DER signing, certificate and SPKI verification, tampering/encoding/unrelated-key/algorithm rejection and explicit unsupported legacy routing. macOS execution, DSA certificate boundaries and native assets not-tested under PIN-699.

Windows paired compile/run: imported DSA fixture and real ECDSA P256/SHA256/DER signing, certificate and SPKI verification, tampering/encoding/unrelated-key/algorithm rejection and explicit unsupported legacy routing. macOS execution, DSA certificate boundaries and native assets not-tested under PIN-699.

humanProof.scope: Unavailable macOS native checks: .NET10 imported DSA1024/SHA1/P1363 verification/tamper rejection; .NET11 DSA.Create/DSACryptoServiceProvider/DSA certificate access platform failures; both releases' ECDSA certificate/key access, new signing/verification, encoding/tamper rejection and unsupported legacy handling. Windows compilation/execution retained. No Apple native artifact inspection. PIN-699 permits exact sample-specific exclusions without another environment prerequisite; Pingu owns feasible interactive approvals/refresh coordination.
